text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
@Gideon, I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your first report was at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug: the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant, with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. Meanwhile, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03, and the guard checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07.

I made a mistake in my first reply: I called INC-4821 the postmortem ticket. In the channel, you only attached the status-page screenshot to INC-4821. I posted a correction, but I don't know which ticket the postmortem uses.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
